H05-01: Inspection of username and password fields for specific format helper text.
Pass: Registration/signup credentials have explicit formatting instructions.
Fail: Password/username fields lack helper text or have vague instructions.
1. Select type="password" and username fields. Skip login forms or current-password fields.
2. Look for helper text via aria-describedby, siblings, or title.
3. If text exists, check for specific criteria keywords (e.g., "length", "number", "character").
If a password field lacks any instructions:
- Add helper text using aria-describedby to explain the required password format before the user submits.
If a password field has helper text, but it lacks specific criteria:
- Update the helper text to explicitly state the minimum length and required character types (e.g., numbers, symbols).
If a username field lacks any instructions:
- Add helper text using aria-describedby to explain the allowed username format.
If a username field has helper text, but lacks format constraints:
- Update the helper text to explicitly state length constraints and allowed characters (e.g., alphanumeric only).
